name: Upload for Jelly
description: Accepts photo uploads from a client and files them into a photo library.
overview: Photo upload endpoint for photo libraries.
changelog: Runs on Jellyfin 12: the same binary serves 10.11.6 and later, and was tested on 10.11.6 and 12.4 with identical results. Have now refuses an oversize body with 413 TOO_LARGE instead of a 500 the client would retry, and an upload that runs the volume out of space answers 507 INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE instead of a retryable 500. Requires Jellyfin 10.11.6 or later. The endpoints may still change before 1.0.0.0.
